We aim to have Burger Nights on the 1st & 3rd Mondays of each month, meaning the next Burger Nights are 4/7/25 & 4/21/25! Reservations recommended on OpenTable, and we will accept as many walk-ins as we can! Delicious burgers made from premium ingredients, wine and oyster specials, and more! Don’t miss out! DINNER RESERVATIONS! We are now open for dinner service Thursday through Sunday! We’ll be accepting limited walk-ins and reservations on OpenTable. For brunch, we still do not take reservations as we seat guests on a first come first serve basis. However, you can join our Yelp! Waitlist to save your spot ahead of time (same day only)! PARKING INFO DO NOT park in Rick’s parking lot - they WILL TOW at all times of the day! The open parking lot directly behind our restaurant has 2 hour free parking, or is free after 5:00PM. Nearby, South and North of Main St on 1st St, there are two parking structures with 4 hour free parking. BUSINESS HOURS BRUNCH: Thursday, Friday & Monday 9:00am - 2:00pm Saturday & Sunday 9:00am - 2:30pm DINNER: Thursday & Sunday 5:00pm - 9:00pm Friday & Saturday 5:00pm - 10:00pm Burger Night 1st and 3rd Mondays of Each Month 5:00pm - 9:00pm CLOSED Tuesdays & Wednesdays Dine-in, takeout, and delivery (via DoorDash & UberEats) available ORDER ONLINE CAREERS - send us a resume/short message! LOCATION 112 W Main St. Alhambra, CA 91801 HOURS Brunch: Thursday, Friday & Monday, 9am to 2:00pm Saturday & Sunday, 9am to 2:30pm Dinner: Thursday & Sunday, 5pm to 9pm Friday & Saturday, 5pm to 10pm Closed Tuesdays & Wednesdays Burger Nights on the 1st & 3rd Monday of each month from 5pm to 9pm CONTACT (626) 281-1035 hello@yangskitchenla.com Images shot on location at Yang's Kitchen Yang’s Kitchen strives to source local, sustainable and organic when possible. We work hard to source premium ingredients and we cook everything from scratch with love. We also do our best to pay our employees living wages (tips are shared with all employees, including kitchen staff) and to reduce our environmental footprint wherever we can. Overall, these factors translate to higher menu prices, but we hope that you find value and feel a sense of comfort in knowing that we aim to get better everyday at doing what is important to us. LOCATION 112 W Main St. Alhambra, CA 91801 Here are directions to our location. We hope to see you soon!
